scope: A floating-point consistency check using actual combined raw error, the saved original estimator's residual and NRMSE, and a numerically enumerated restricted gain. It is not an interval-arithmetic certificate, not a new proof of the theorem, and not a deployable certificate because epsilon uses simulated ground truth.
source_hash_interpretation: recorded_sources and recorded_source_file_sha256 describe the original acquisition records under neutral component names. These hashes are not claims that the distributed source bytes generated the recorded trials. distribution_source_hashes authenticates the distributed implementation. Numerical cells, seeds, failed trials, and numeric arrays retain their recorded values; private calendar and local-machine metadata are omitted.
